verdict.rationale: Evidence shows official OS support for RHEL and Ubuntu (x86-64) and community confirmation that the chip performs excellently for Linux developers, indicating baseline tooling/OS support. However there is no evidence of AMD-specific compiler optimization guides, toolchain documentation, or explicit 'tier one' ecosystem commitments beyond general x86-64 compatibility. missing for 10: dedicated compiler/optimization documentation, evidence of first-class support in major toolchains (GCC/LLVM/MSVC) beyond generic x86-64 compatibility, and explicit AMD developer guidance for this architecture.
